cards.ex: We need to decide soon – time is running out to book our flights.
cards.exUz: Tez orada qaror qabul qilishimiz kerak - parvozlarimizni bron qilish uchun vaqt tugayapti.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt oz qolayotganini, qilingan ishlar tugashi kerakligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: She's dead set on finishing the project by Friday, no matter what.
cards.exUz: U loyihani juma kuniga qadar tugatishga qat'iy qaror qilgan, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga juda qat'iy qaror qilgan bo'lish.

cards.ex: The negotiations felt like a ticking clock; every minute mattered.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar vaqt o'tib borayotgandek tuyuldi; har bir daqiqa muhim edi.
cards.uzDef: Bosim ostida qilingan ish, vaqt oz qolgan.

cards.ex: The project deadline isn't set in stone, so we might be able to negotiate it.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muddati qotib qolmagan, shuning uchun uni muhokama qilishimiz mumkin.

cards.ex: He's ready to travel at a moment's notice if the client needs him.
cards.exUz: Agar mijozga kerak bo'lsa, u bir zumda sayohat qilishga tayyor.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline for the next quarter.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi chorak uchun bir nechta yangi loyihalar rejalashtirilgan.

cards.ex: We'll need to address these issues down the line, but not right now.
cards.exUz: Bu masalalarni kelajakda hal qilishimiz kerak bo'ladi, lekin hozir emas.

cards.ex: The train arrived to the minute, which was quite surprising.
cards.exUz: Poyezd daqiqasiga keldi, bu juda hayratlanarli edi.

cards.ex: We're behind the eight ball on this project because of the initial delays.
cards.exUz: Boshlang'ich kechikishlar tufayli biz ushbu loyihada qiyin ahvoldamiz.

cards.ex: We should get a head start on the report this weekend to avoid a last-minute rush.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi daqiqalarda shoshilishdan qochish uchun ushbu hafta oxirida hisobotni erta boshlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ishni erta boshlab, afzalliklarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Don't put off filing your taxes until the last minute; do it now.
cards.exUz: Soliqlaringizni to'lashni oxirgi daqiqagacha kechiktirmang; hozir qiling.

cards.ex: Upon receiving the news, they lost no time in organizing a response.
cards.exUz: Xabarni olgach, ular darhol javobni tashkil qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez harakat qilish, vaqtni bekorga o'tkazmaslik.

cards.ex: We provide up-to-the-minute news coverage on our website.
cards.exUz: Biz veb-saytimizda eng so'nggi yangiliklarni yoritib boramiz.

cards.ex: The project manager keeps the team on a short leash to ensure deadlines are met.
cards.exUz: Loyiha menejeri muddatlar bajarilishini ta'minlash uchun jamoani qattiq nazorat ostida ushlab turadi.

cards.ex: Now that I'm retired, I have a lot of time on my hands.
cards.exUz: Endi nafaqaga chiqqanimdan keyin, mening ko'p bo'sh vaqtim bor.
cards.uzDef: Qilishga ko'p ishi yo'qligi, bo'sh vaqti ko'pligi.

cards.ex: We made good time on the drive, arriving an hour earlier than expected.
cards.exUz: Biz haydashda yaxshi tezlikka erishdik va kutilganidan bir soat oldin yetib keldik.

cards.ex: We've put the expansion plans on the back burner until we secure more funding.
cards.exUz: Biz ko'proq mablag' olmagunimizcha, kengaytirish rejalarini keyinga qoldirdik.

cards.ex: The time frame for completing the project is six months.
cards.exUz: Loyihani yakunlash uchun vaqt oralig'i olti oy.

cards.ex: By all accounts, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
cards.exUz: Hamma aytishicha, loyiha belgilangan muddatdan oldin yakunlangan.

cards.ex: With the deadline approaching, skilled workers are at a premium.
cards.exUz: Muddat yaqinlashgani sababli, malakali ishchilar qimmat.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan qimmatroq, talab yuqori bo'lganligi sababli.

cards.ex: We're in the home stretch now; just a few more tasks to complete.
cards.exUz: Biz hozir yakuniy qismdamiz; faqat bir nechta vazifani bajarish kerak.

cards.ex: Despite the challenges, we decided to press ahead with the project.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, biz loyihani davom ettirishga qaror qildik.

cards.ex: After years of hard work, his dream finally came to fruition.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mehnatdan so'ng, uning orzusi nihoyat amalga oshdi.

cards.ex: There's no time to lose; we need to act immediately.
cards.exUz: Vaqt yo'qotishga yo'l yo'q; biz darhol harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tez harakat qilish kerak, vaqtni yo'qotmaslik.

cards.ex: The boss gave us a deadline of next Friday to finish the report.
cards.exUz: Boshliq hisobotni tugatish uchun kelgusi juma kunini muddat qilib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Ishni tugatish uchun aniq vaqt belgilash.

cards.ex: The meeting started dead on time, which was a pleasant surprise.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuv aniq vaqtida boshlandi, bu yoqimli ajablanish edi.

cards.ex: The new regulations will take effect on January 1st.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar 1-yanvardan kuchga kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun, qoida yoki qaror kuchga kirmoq.

cards.ex: We're on a tight schedule this week, so meetings need to be efficient.
cards.exUz: Biz bu hafta qattiq jadvaldamiz, shuning uchun uchrashuvlar samarali bo'lishi kerak.

cards.ex: Every so often, we need to review our progress and make adjustments.
cards.exUz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan biz o'z yutuqlarimizni ko'rib chiqishimiz va tuzatishlar kiritishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The project seems to be marking time; we need to inject some new ideas.
cards.exUz: Loyiha joyida tepinayotgandek; biz unga yangi g'oyalarni kiritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday o'zgarishsiz yoki taraqqiyotsiz qolish.
